data.long_meaning: Bivas is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Bhiva', which means 'living'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is the preserver and sustainer of the universe. The name Bivas signifies the one who preserves and sustains life, and is therefore considered a powerful and spiritual name. The name Bivas carries the meaning “Lord of Living” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bivas usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of living and live with faith, good character and purpose.
